pipeline: Source cutout segmentation; inverse nearest-neighbor affine limb poses; translated original head; cape rotation and row flutter; padded composition; per-sheet height and bbox centering; material-specific 1px inner outline; exact 8x nearest-neighbor. No image generation.

Hero_Run.pose_notes: Alternating contact, push, flight-shaped legs and landing. Ground anchor retained in flight-shaped frames per import rule.

Hero_JumpStart.pose_notes: Crouch then extended takeoff with raised arm; airborne second frame.

Hero_Fall.pose_notes: Upturned cape; separated legs and slight flutter.

Hero_Land.pose_notes: Crouch expressed through knees and cape; crown varies by only two rows.

Hero_Dash.pose_notes: Low forward lean; horizontal cape. Padded composition preserves complete torso before cell fitting.

Hero_Death.pose_notes: Stagger, buckle to knees, roll onto side, fully prone final frame within cell.

limitations: Source cutout editing has no newly drawn occluded anatomy; extreme poses retain source-side lighting.
Run flight-shaped frames retain ground alignment as explicitly required.
Crouch depth is restricted by per-sheet height tolerance.
Death animation preview loops for inspection; gameplay should hold the last frame.
No engine import or gameplay test performed.
